I'm tracking how each object's shape sits above its box and figuring out where it lands after shifting the top row down—checking the left box pattern first, then applying the same shift logic to the right box's object.

I'm second-guessing whether these dot clusters count as one connected shape or separate ones, since diagonal versus orthogonal adjacency would change the outcome significantly. The corner-touching pixels make this ambiguous, but since the earlier example used a single connected plus-shape object, I'll lean toward treating this as one diagonally-connected object too, keeping the split between the row of two dots and the row of three dots when it moves down.
